title: OpenAI's AI Wrote 700 Math Papers. Engineers Still Won't Trust AI With Their Code.
channel: AI News & Strategy Daily | Nate B Jones

description_excerpt:

title: Google Has More Data Than Almost Anyone. So Why Is It Bidding $10 Million On Old Emails?
channel: AI News & Strategy Daily | Nate B Jones
source_name: Nate B Jones (AI News & Strategy Daily)
description_excerpt:
Google bid $10 million for Spirit Airlines' old work emails and Teams records to train AI agents. A lot of the value people create at work never shows up in those records, and that matters for your job and for how AI learns.
